title: ParsedBill
description: Fields extracted from a single utility or vendor bill document. Any field that is not printed on the document is omitted entirely rather than guessed.

vendor_name.description: The company issuing the bill, as printed. Omit if not shown.

account_number.description: Customer or account number, digits and separators exactly as printed. Omit if not shown.

invoice_number.description: Invoice, bill or statement number. Omit if not shown.

service_address.description: The address the service was supplied to, on one line. Omit if not shown.

utility_type.description: What is being billed. Use 'other' for a vendor invoice rather than a utility.

billing_period_start.description: First day of the billing period, strictly YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if not printed or ambiguous.

billing_period_end.description: Last day of the billing period, strictly YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if not printed or ambiguous.

statement_date.description: Date the bill was issued, strictly YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if not printed or ambiguous.

due_date.description: Payment due date, strictly YYYY-MM-DD. Omit if not printed or ambiguous.

meter_number.description: Meter or serial identifier. Omit if the bill shows none.

previous_read.description: Previous meter reading as a plain number, no units or separators.

current_read.description: Current meter reading as a plain number, no units or separators.

consumption.description: Quantity consumed over the period as a plain number.

consumption_unit.description: Unit for the consumption figure, e.g. kWh, m3, kL, GJ, therms.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, e.g. USD, AUD, GBP, AED, INR.

subtotal.description: Amount before tax as a plain number, no currency symbol or thousands separators.

tax.description: Total tax, VAT or GST as a plain number.

total_amount.description: Total amount payable for this bill as a plain number. The single most important field.

line_items.description: Individual charges listed on the bill. Empty array if none are itemised.

description.description: What the charge is for, as printed.

quantity.description: Quantity for this line, as a plain number.

unit_price.description: Price per unit for this line, as a plain number.

amount.description: Line total, as a plain number.

provenance.description: For each field you filled in, the verbatim text from the document that you read the value from. This is shown to a human next to the document so they can check your work. Include one entry per non-empty field, using the exact field name from this schema.

field.description: The schema field name this evidence supports, e.g. total_amount, billing_period_start.

source_text.description: The exact line or phrase as printed on the document, copied verbatim, that the value came from. Keep it short — one line is ideal.

page.description: 1-based page number the text appeared on, if the document has pages.

confidence.description: Confidence that the document was read correctly overall. Use 'low' when it is blurry, cropped, handwritten, or not clearly a bill.

notes.description: Short note for the human reviewer: anything unreadable, ambiguous, or worth double-checking. Omit if the read was clean.
